items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: They would jam all night and all morning, any time of the day, you could find them. Charlie Parker, Joe Jones, Lester.

ctx.x: Yes. Yes, Kansas City was a swinging, swinging town. Much more swinging than Los Angeles, I mean as far as guys jamming.
They would jam all night and all morning, any time of the day, you could find them. Charlie Parker, Joe Jones, Lester. They had battles, you know. They would stay up until one o'clock, two o'clock.
You'd left Herschel Evans out on the West Coast?
